primary.title: Bengaluru couple spends ₹9 lakh yearly on travel as biggest household expense, ₹60,000 on rent: ‘We’re not tracking…’
primary.summary: An IT couple shared their monthly budget of ₹1.73 lakh in Bengaluru, covering their rent, transport, groceries and more. However, their biggest expense was their travel budget.
